document: ET-VII E-E — the elicitation gap, measured. Δ IS LARGE AND MATERIAL on the stratum where policy identity buys nothing.
prereg: docs/et7-ee-prereg.md + §3a amendment (both committed before the run)
judge: mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit, layer 18 · 1,050 decisive pairs over 205 problems

PRIMARY_balanced_pairs.what_it_is: the two policy pairs where the stronger model is correct only 49.0% / 43.9% of the time, so POLICY IDENTITY CARRIES NO INFORMATION ABOUT CORRECTNESS (§3a)
PRIMARY_balanced_pairs.control_reading: permutation collapses to the baseline; PCA-8 SEPARATES (0.657 against 0.730 — eight dimensions do not suffice); the policy-identity probe sits near chance (0.577), which is what the balancing was for. The subsample matching is a known property of this probe family and is not on its own a flag.
PRIMARY_balanced_pairs.verdict: Δ = +0.482. The judge picks correctly 24.8% of the time — BELOW the 51.8% majority baseline, because TIE counts as wrong and it ties often — while a linear probe on its own hidden states reaches 73.0%. The registered prediction (Δ > 0 and material) is confirmed on this stratum.

SECONDARY_confounded_pairs.verdict: WITHDRAWN per the registered rule. PCA-8 (0.834) matches the probe (0.838) and the policy-identity probe reaches 0.826 — exactly the confound §3a predicted for these pairs. The Δ here is not reported as a finding.

🔴_AN_EVALUATION_CORRECTION_MADE_BEFORE_A.what_happened: the first pass held out 25% of problems, leaving n=38 test cells on the primary stratum. On that split PCA-8 read 0.789 against a probe at 0.763 — the control FIRED, and my §4 rule says a fired control withdraws the Δ.
🔴_AN_EVALUATION_CORRECTION_MADE_BEFORE_A.what_was_wrong: n=38 was too thin to measure its own controls. The permutation control on that split spanned 0.42-0.66 against a 0.53 baseline; a control whose own spread is ±0.12 cannot adjudicate a 0.03 gap.
🔴_AN_EVALUATION_CORRECTION_MADE_BEFORE_A.the_fix: 5-fold CV OVER PROBLEMS (never over pairs — two pairs from one problem share its text), so every one of the 137 cells is evaluated instead of 38. The controls then behave: permutation collapses, PCA-8 separates by 0.073, policy-identity falls from 0.684 to 0.577.
🔴_AN_EVALUATION_CORRECTION_MADE_BEFORE_A.why_this_is_not_moving_the_goalposts: the thinness was registered as a risk IN THE PRE-REGISTRATION ('137 cells held out BY PROBLEM is thin, and if the held-out split is too small to carry an interval, that is reported as the arm's limit'). The fix uses the SAME cells, the same states and the same controls — it changes how many of them are scored, not which ones count. Both evaluations are committed; the 25% split is in et7_ee_holdout25.json.

shallow_explanations_tested_and_rejected.answer_length: 'the longer answer is correct' holds 43.1% of the time on the primary stratum — below chance, so a length-reading probe would score ~57% by inverting, not 73%
shallow_explanations_tested_and_rejected.policy_identity: the probe CAN identify the stronger model (0.577 on balanced pairs) but on those pairs stronger-is-correct only 49%/44% of the time, so that knowledge cannot produce 73% correctness accuracy

NOT_YET_MEASURED: the second half of the concept's registration — 'Δ shrinks with judge scale slower than A rises' — needs ≥3 judges. This is ONE judge. The 1.5B and 14B arms are running; 32B after. Until they land, the scaling claim is unmeasured and is not made.

🔵_THE_DECOMPOSITION_THAT_SHARPENS_IT.🔑_the_sentence: the PROBE's accuracy over ALL cells (73.0%) is essentially the JUDGE's accuracy on the third of cells where it commits (73.9%). The elicitation gap here is ABSTENTION, not ignorance: the state carries what the judge would say if it spoke, on the two thirds of pairs where it declines to speak.
🔵_THE_DECOMPOSITION_THAT_SHARPENS_IT.why_TIE_still_counts_wrong: registered before the run, and rightly: an unexpressed judgment is not a judgment, and a judge that refuses two thirds of the time is useless as a selector whatever its hidden state knows. Δ = +0.482 stands as the headline. This decomposition says WHAT the gap is made of, and it is the more useful half for ET-VII's E-D arm, whose whole subject is whether the unexpressed part can be elicited.
🔵_THE_DECOMPOSITION_THAT_SHARPENS_IT.⚠️_a_line_I_nearly_published: my own analysis script printed a closing sentence asserting the judge is 'a coin flip when it commits'. It is 73.9%. The narrative was written into the script ahead of the numbers and the numbers contradicted it — caught only because the script printed the counts beside the claim.

1.5B_judge_first_scaling_point.reading: the 1.5B judge essentially never commits. Its A is not a measure of discrimination but of format compliance, and its Δ (+0.579) is inflated by an A crushed to zero. Reported as the arm's floor and NOT used in the scaling curve without the TIE rate printed beside it.
